provenance.author: Codex
provenance.source: Manually authored task descriptions, not sampled from catalog names/descriptions or existing generated queries. Author saw the system taxonomy and search code.
limitations: Not shopper logs or human-authored queries.
Small exploratory challenge set; not representative traffic.
Test split is frozen for local ablations, not proof against broader model training contamination.

queries.query: something to keep office chatter out while I work
queries.intent: Over-ear or in-ear audio with explicit noise isolation/cancellation evidence. Generic speakers are unsuitable.

queries.query: carry a computer safely through the rain
queries.intent: A carrying bag with a padded computer compartment and explicit water resistance. A computer itself does not meet the task.

queries.query: less strain on my feet during a full shift standing
queries.intent: Footwear with documented cushioning/support for extended wear. Fashion category membership alone is weak evidence.

queries.query: keep lunch warm until my afternoon break
queries.intent: An insulated food container suitable for a meal. An uninsulated box only partly addresses the need.

queries.query: wirless earbds
queries.intent: Wireless earbuds. Judge the intended corrected request, not the spelling.

queries.query: lapotp bakpack
queries.intent: A backpack designed to carry a laptop. Neither a laptop nor a generic handbag is an exact match.

queries.query: rechargable trimer
queries.intent: A rechargeable grooming trimmer. Disposable razors and replacement-only blades are unsuitable.

queries.query: stainles steel botle
queries.intent: A reusable stainless steel bottle. Plastic bottles do not meet the material request.

queries.query: wireless headphones under 3000 rupees
queries.intent: Wireless headphones within the explicit budget; do not award full relevance based on category alone.

queries.query: a work laptop between 30000 and 50000 rupees
queries.intent: A laptop suited to office work within the price range, with sufficient specification evidence.

queries.query: running footwear below 2500 rupees
queries.intent: Running footwear within the budget. Casual footwear without running-use evidence is at most partially relevant.

queries.query: desk lamp no more than 1500 rupees
queries.intent: A desk/task lamp within budget. Other desk accessories do not satisfy the request.

queries.query: available yoga mat
queries.intent: A yoga mat currently in stock.

queries.query: in stock insulated lunch box
queries.intent: An insulated meal container currently in stock; stock and insulation both matter.

queries.query: available usb c cable under 800
queries.intent: An in-stock USB-C cable within the price cap. Adapters and chargers are not exact substitutes.

queries.query: in stock blue cotton shirt
queries.intent: An in-stock shirt made from cotton in blue. Evidence must support all requested attributes.

queries.query: notebook for handwritten meeting notes
queries.intent: A paper notebook for writing, not a notebook computer.

queries.query: stand for watching videos on my phone
queries.intent: A physical phone stand. A smartphone alone is unsuitable.

queries.query: mouse for a small travel desk
queries.intent: A compact computer pointing device. Animal-themed toys are unsuitable.

queries.query: lightweight case for spectacles
queries.intent: A protective glasses case; general luggage or a phone case is unsuitable.

queries.query: black running shoes with a mesh upper
queries.intent: Running footwear with explicit mesh material and black color.

queries.query: small bluetooth speaker to use outdoors
queries.intent: A portable wireless speaker with evidence of outdoor suitability. Headphones do not satisfy the request.

queries.query: backpack with room for a 15 inch laptop and a bottle
queries.intent: A backpack whose documented compartments accommodate the stated laptop and a bottle. Do not infer dimensions from its category.

queries.query: fragrance free sunscreen for daily use
queries.intent: Sunscreen explicitly documented as fragrance-free. Other skincare products are not substitutes.

queries.query: replacement left hinge for model zxq 441 laptop
queries.intent: An exact compatible replacement hinge. Generic laptops/accessories are irrelevant; zero relevant catalog products may be correct.

queries.query: spare charging cradle for orbit pulse 73
queries.intent: An exact compatible charging cradle for the named fictional model. Do not invent compatibility; no relevant products may exist.

queries.query: book in Icelandic about repairing accordion reeds
queries.intent: A book meeting language and narrow topic constraints. Generic books/stationery are irrelevant.

queries.query: glass bottle that holds exactly 37 litres
queries.intent: A glass bottle with explicit 37-litre capacity. Do not infer size; no relevant products may exist.
